articles.summary: Two conversations at Medicaid Innovations - one focused on Medicaid renewals, the other on H.R. 1 implementation - kept circling the same realization: this is not an eligibility redetermination story. It’s a sustained compliance, verification, and communications challenge, landing on systems that are already under pressure.
articles.title: How Medicaid Leaders are Preparing for H.R. 1: Operational Readiness at Scale
